page_title: BAY 2-2 DOR | Bayern Munich v Dortmund 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' The cross fools the defence and leaves Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
90+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips in a cross from the corner, but Gregor Kobel is well positioned and punches the ball away.

90+2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) fails to keep his cool and squanders a golden chance to score from inside the penalty area after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
89' The defence successfully catches Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) in the offside trap, but it was close!
86' Dortmund fail to score from a corner as Jonas Urbig (Bayern Munich) leaps to collect the ball.
86' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Dortmund.
85' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) plays a through ball but overhits it.
83' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 25:9.
81' Substitution. Thomas Muller leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich).
81' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Niklas Sule is replaced by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund).
81' The game has come to an end for Maximilian Beier. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).

80' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
79' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

77' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
76' The attendance is 75000.
75' 2 - 2 Goal! Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 2:2.
75' A tremendous drive by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Jonas Urbig makes a brilliant save.
75' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
73' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
71' Julian Brandt comes off the pitch to be replaced by Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
71' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) replacing Salih Ozcan.

69' 2 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 2:1. Gregor Kobel was helpless.
68' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
68' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
65' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Thomas Muller laid the ball off to Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
65' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
63' Here is a change. Leroy Sane is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
63' Substitution. Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) on for Leon Goretzka.
63' The corner from Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is intercepted by Jonas Urbig.
62' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.

60' That was close by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
58' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
57' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
56' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
54' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Min-Jae Kim will be replaced by Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich).

53' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) hits the free kick from the edge of the box, but can't find the target. His shot flies miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
52' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Welz saw the whole situation. Dortmund have a free kick.
51' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
48' 0 - 1 Goal! Julian Ryerson picks out Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom left corner with a header from close range. 0:1.
47' An attempted cross from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends the corner into the box, but Gregor Kobel intercepts it and averts the threat.

45+2' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Gregor Kobel anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Dortmund couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jonas Urbig (Bayern Munich) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

44' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Dortmund are awarded the free kick.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Dortmund.
43' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
43' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Welz blows for a foul. Dortmund win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
42' Gregor Kobel comes off his line to intercept the corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).
41' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players. Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.
41' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.

40' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.

39' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) can bury his head in the sand! He misses the rebound from the edge of the box as he plants a header well wide of the right post! A typical school boy error! The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
38' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
37' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
35' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

34' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
34' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
32' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.
30' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
28' A pass from Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Gregor Kobel and the move breaks down.

26' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
25' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
23' Tobias Welz blows his whistle and it's Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
20' Gregor Kobel makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom left corner by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich).

19' Excellent touch by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
18' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregor Kobel intercepts the ball.
16' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

13' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.

11' A sweet pass inside the box gives Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
8' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
7' Chance! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
6' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
3' Bayern Munich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The match has just started.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
